reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_duration` -> `envoy_cilium_npds_update_duration`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The metric is now exported as envoy_cilium_npds_update_duration, so queries that use the old envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_duration name no longer match it.
consequence.remediation: Change dashboards, alerts and recording rules to use envoy_cilium_npds_update_duration.

proposed.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the Envoy metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_duration` is renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_update_duration`.
